name: Wolfpine First Cleaned Asset Review
purpose: Visual/layout review gate for the first five Wolfpine PNG assets after they are promoted to cleaned status.
global_review_checks: PNG file exists at the canonical intended_file path.
Manifest sha256 matches the committed PNG.
Alpha edge does not show white/black haloing on neutral or dark backgrounds.
Contact shadow direction does not conflict with Wolfpine village lighting.
Silhouette remains readable at expected game scale.
Object footprint can be represented with simple collision or hotspot bounds.
Asset reads as painted/pre-rendered CRPG art rather than pixel art or clean RTS art.
No readable real-world text, labels, modern materials, or UI elements are baked in.
Asset does not block required routes, doors, exits, or hotspot approach arcs.

assets.recommended_use: Village square focal object and interaction anchor.
specific_review_checks: Readable as a stone village well at game scale.
Roof/crossbeam does not become a large foreground occluder.
Actor approach space remains clear on at least two sides.
Ground contact and shadow work on mud/cobble placement.
Hotspot silhouette is clear without requiring outline/highlight.
accepted_only_if: Well can be placed near the square without blocking primary movement.
The roof and bucket/crank details remain legible at game scale.

assets.recommended_use: Quest board or village information hotspot near crossroads or inn edge.
specific_review_checks: Reads as a notice board, not a door or freestanding signpost.
Contains no readable real-world text.
Has a clear interaction-facing side.
Does not visually compete with building doors or exit markers.
Parchment shapes remain readable without becoming noisy.
accepted_only_if: Quest-board function is readable in the Wolfpine village context.
The asset supports hotspot interaction without needing text baked into the texture.

assets.recommended_use: Ground-level modular door for inn, storehouse, or guarded building facades.
specific_review_checks: Reads unambiguously as a door, not a window or panel.
Scale is consistent with actor height and Wolfpine building facades.
Threshold implies a walkable approach at ground level.
Hinges/latch support medieval dark-fantasy material language.
Lantern/detail does not become a gameplay hotspot unless explicitly configured.
accepted_only_if: Door can be attached to a building facade without perspective conflict.
Door approach remains clear and readable in layout context.

assets.recommended_use: Small modular shuttered window for timber/plaster Wolfpine facades.
specific_review_checks: Reads clearly as a window and cannot be mistaken for an entrance.
Scale is smaller than modular doors.
Shutters and frame match timber/plaster Wolfpine architecture.
Warm light or dark interior does not dominate the facade.
Can be placed above ground level without implying player access.
accepted_only_if: Window works on at least one starter facade without perspective mismatch.
Window remains a background architecture detail rather than a false hotspot.

assets.recommended_use: Cottage, inn, and blacksmith-side utility clutter.
specific_review_checks: Reads as stacked firewood at small prop scale.
Grounding works beside buildings and forge work areas.
Does not block doors, exits, or hotspot approach arcs.
Texture detail is readable but not visually noisy.
Can combine with crates/barrels without becoming a clutter wall.
accepted_only_if: Works beside both cottage/inn and blacksmith contexts.
Footprint is easy to represent in collision or non-walkable masking.

review_outcomes.accepted: Promote the individual asset to accepted only after visual/layout review passes and validators still pass.
review_outcomes.cleaned: Keep as cleaned if the asset is usable but needs placement, alpha, scale, or contact-shadow iteration.
review_outcomes.rejected: Reject if style, perspective, readability, or route-blocking issues cannot be corrected cheaply.
